## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text attributed to [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98) Ān Shìgāo treats the Mahāyāna doctrine of the *bǎo jī sānmèi* (*Ratna-kūṭa-samādhi*) and the *fǎ shēn* (*dharmakāya*). Modern scholarship (Nattier 2008) is somewhat sceptical of the traditional ascription to Ān Shìgāo, given the Mahāyāna character of the text, but the attribution is preserved by the canonical tradition.
